Copyright Three.js Authors. Distributed under the MIT license in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Core: `three.module.js`, `three.core.js`. Addons: `GLTFLoader.js`, `BufferGeometryUtils.js`, `VRButton.js`, `RectAreaLightUniformsLib.js`, `RectAreaLightTexturesLib.js`.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

Addon import specifiers are adapted to `../three.module.js`; addon-to-addon imports remain local. Algorithms and bundled lookup data are unchanged. The version matches all former Forest and Scene Test vendor files.
